profile.headline: Software Engineer at Curi
profile.summary:
I'm a detail-oriented full stack software engineer who’s passionate about delivering well-researched, high-impact solutions. I strive for excellence in everything I do, always looking for the most effective and thoughtful approach to any problem, question, or challenge. I enjoy thinking strategically and deeply, embracing new and creative ideas, and following them through to execution with precision and care.

I thrive as a key contributor on a team - not because I need to lead, but because I love being a trusted expert who helps move the work forward. I'm motivated by the impact of my contributions and aim to provide clarity and direction that drives meaningful outcomes. I have a strong sense of how systems and solutions fit together, and I focus on making sure every piece of work supports the bigger picture and long-term success of the team.

positions.title: Pigture
positions.description: Full-stack app to help pig farmers easily estimate the weight of their pigs with two simple pictures.  Weighing pigs on a commercial farm comes with a great deal of time and effort.  By simply taking a frontal and lateral picture of your pig, Pigture's algorithm will produce an accurate total weight of your pig and its cuts.

positions.title: Housing Carousel
positions.description:
- Identified system bottlenecks with K6, New Relic, and Loader.io to prioritize higher read/write operations
- Horizontally scaled 6 Node/Express servers and 2 Cassandra databases on AWS EC2 with NGINX 
load-balancers to support 3000RPS with <1% error rate
- Reduced database read latency from 250ms to <15ms by refactoring and indexing the Cassandra schema

positions.title: HQSound
positions.description:
- Deployed 5 dockerized modules on separate EC2 micro services to improve reusability, flexibility, and scalability
- Optimized page load speed to <200ms through text compression, caching large mp3 files, and pictures
- Rendered unique frequency waveform visualizations by utilizing native HTML5 Web Audio API
- Developed unit and end-to-end tests with Jest and Enzyme to guide test-driven development

positions.title: Sales Product Management
positions.description:
Sales                                                                                                                                                 
●	Develop and maintain a business relationship with 75 buyers to distribute our product, the Malaria Rapid Diagnostic test (mRDT).
●	Correspond daily with the production, purchasing, QC, R&D and PCO team to efficiently streamline the manufacturing and shipping of products.
●	Analyze previous and current sales data of mRDT to determine a competitive price point to enable actions from the CEO.
●	Communicate with over 200+ customers worldwide in technical, logistical, and business support.
●	Oversee and cross reference shipping data with purchase orders resulting in 100% legal compliance.

Marketing                                                                                                 
●	Act as liaison for Access Bio to showcase their product at trade shows around the world.
●	Analyzed logistical specifications for the packaging and transport of goods in favor of customer savings in comparison to competitor packaging.
●	Drive customer retention with data analyzed from logistical specifications for packaging and transport of goods.
●	Obtain technical data from our R&D team and translate it into marketing materials for the general public.

Business Development  
●	Lead and manage a cross functional team to develop business proposals with other companies, resulting in positive margins for Access Bio.
●	Coordinated, reviewed and revised the licensing agreement from start-to-finish for mRDT between: Access Bio, General Electric and Intellectual Ventures. 
●	Wrote and revised the press release articles for Access Bio when agreements between GE/IV and Atomo were made.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Collaborated with a MD doctor in the research of corneal fibrosis due to injury or disease
- Managed personal care of experimental animals while meticulously organizing all solutions and materials needed for experiments
- Conducted Western Blots, PCRs, and various other experimental procedures such as separating corneas from mice, rabbit, and human eyes

company.name: UNIVERSITY OF MINNESOTA DEPARTMENT OF OPHTHALMOLOGY

volunteerExperiences.description: Maintained a healthy and inviting environment for patients living in the Ronald McDonald House by cleaning living quarters, organizing resident documents, and playing with children
Organized and promoted events on campus to encourage minorities to join the bone marrow registry

projects.title: NomNom
projects.description:
Developer Week 2020 TomTom Hackathon
- Hackathon project utilizing TomTom API to help solve the concern of food waste
- Collaborated with a team to build out a minimal viable product within 48hrs to alleviate food waste from businesses and guide drivers to consumers
- Designed and constructed the backend with Express/Node.js and MongoDB to allow communication between 3 separate applications
- Implemented RESTful API to support CRUD operations on a mutual database system
